newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait reports Iraqi boat shooting to U.N..
newsitem.headline: Kuwait reports Iraqi boat shooting to U.N..

text.p: Kuwait has complained to the United Nations about an incident this month in which an Iraqi boat opened fire at two Kuwaiti vessels, the official Kuwait News Agency reported.

"Kuwait officially informed the United Nations today about the aggression a Kuwaiti coast guard patrol and a civilian boat were exposed to by an Iraqi boat," the agency said in a report from New York late on Wednesday.

"Such a provocative act by the Iraqi regime, in adition to being a violation to Kuwaiti borders and territorial waters, is a threat to the security of the region," Kuwait's message to the United Nations said.
The agency said the incident occurred near Kuwait's Bubiyan island on April 12. It did not say if there were any injuries.
Iraq invaded Kuwait in August 1990 and occupied the Gulf Arab state for seven months before a U.S.-led coalition drove out Baghdad's troops.
